name: UGC 2684 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 2684, a nearby dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc2684-hubble
story: A small dwarf galaxy in our cosmic neighborhood, one half of a wide pair of dwarfs that share nearly the same motion along our line of sight.

claims.text: UGC 2684 (listed as U2684) is one of thirty nearby dwarf galaxies in an H-alpha survey, at RA 03 20 23.7, Dec +17 17 42 (J2000), matching this pointing (RA 50.0988, Dec 17.2959)
UGC 2684 forms a wide pair of dwarf galaxies with similar radial velocities (with UGC 2716)
